strings.app.name: nigeyo
strings.onboarding.language.title:
Feel ready.
Find your next step.
strings.onboarding.language.body: Visual disaster guidance, in your language.
strings.onboarding.language.footnote: You can change your language anytime.
strings.onboarding.places.title:
Start with the places
you know.
strings.onboarding.places.body: We'll check evacuation sites near your home and school.
strings.onboarding.places.pinHint: If search doesn't work, drop a pin on the map.
strings.onboarding.places.privacyTitle: We don't save the address you type
strings.onboarding.places.privacyBody: After you choose, only public evacuation site details are saved.
strings.onboarding.places.footnote: You can add your school later.
strings.onboarding.places.noResults: No results. Try dropping a pin on the map.
strings.onboarding.destinations.title:
Separate sites for
earthquakes and tsunamis.
strings.onboarding.destinations.body: Names and addresses are shown exactly as in the official data.
strings.onboarding.destinations.walkUnavailable: Couldn't compare walking distances. Sorted by straight-line distance.
strings.onboarding.destinations.note: Being close does not guarantee safety or that you can reach it.
strings.onboarding.lock.eyebrow: ONE LESS THING TO THINK ABOUT
strings.onboarding.lock.title:
Your next step,
even on the lock screen.
strings.onboarding.lock.body: Set up two shortcuts: earthquake and tsunami.
strings.onboarding.lock.step2Body: Tap to open the setup screen.
strings.onboarding.lock.step3Body: Check both manual and automatic runs.
strings.onboarding.lock.liveActivityBody: Test what shows on the lock screen
strings.onboarding.lock.note: Adding and enabling needs steps on your iPhone.
strings.onboarding.lock.notificationsDenied: Notifications are off. Turn them on in Settings.
strings.home.title:
So you know
what to do.
strings.home.practiceBody:
Follow the screen and
try each action.
strings.home.offlineBody: Maps and external route guidance need a connection.
strings.home.resumeBody: It started over 30 minutes ago. Continue?
strings.home.missingSessionBody: You can start a drill or manual guidance here.
strings.practice.title:
Learn by doing.
One step at a time.
strings.practice.earthquakeBody: Protect head → Safety checks → Evacuation site
strings.practice.tsunamiBody: A tsunami drill alert follows the earthquake
strings.practice.lockBody: A drill notification arrives 5–15 seconds after you start. No real earthquake data is used.
strings.practice.notificationsDenied: Notifications are off, so the drill alert can't be scheduled.
strings.waiting.title:
Lock your iPhone
and wait.
strings.waiting.body: A drill notification is coming. When it arrives, open the guidance once it is safe to use your phone.
strings.waiting.scheduledBody: It stays scheduled even if the screen turns off.
strings.waiting.footnote: This screen won't move to safety checks on its own.
strings.guide.protect.title:
Earthquake.
Protect your head.
strings.guide.protect.body:
Stay low and protect your head.
Use your phone when it is safe to do so.
strings.guide.shakingHint: Only continue once the shaking has stopped.
strings.guide.checks.title:
Stay calm.
Check around you.
strings.guide.surroundings.title: Stay safe
strings.guide.surroundings.body: Watch for glass, furniture, falling objects and your footing.
strings.guide.fire.title: Turn off fire
strings.guide.fire.body: Only once shaking stops and it's safe. Don't go back into danger.
strings.guide.exit.title: Open the door
strings.guide.exit.body: If safe, open a door to keep an exit.
strings.guide.unsafeHint: You can check evacuation sites when needed.
strings.guide.tsunami.title:
Tsunami coming.
Go to high ground.
strings.guide.tsunami.short: Tsunami coming. Go to high ground.
strings.guide.tsunami.body:
There is a tsunami risk.
Move to high ground or a tall, sturdy building.
strings.guide.tsunami.drillBody: It does not mean a real tsunami is happening.
strings.place.title:
Where are
you right now?
strings.place.body: We'll show evacuation sites for where you are.
strings.place.bodyTsunami: Move to high ground. We'll show tsunami-ready evacuation sites.
strings.place.otherBody: Find sites near your current location
strings.place.locationNoteTitle: Location is used only for this
strings.place.locationNoteBody: We'll ask for location access only when needed. Your location isn't saved.
strings.place.tsunamiNote: Even if no tsunami-ready site is nearby, earthquake-only sites won't be shown.
strings.candidates.title: Nearby sites
strings.candidates.body: Earthquake-ready sites, sorted by straight-line distance.
strings.candidates.bodyTsunami: Sorted by straight-line distance from you.
strings.candidates.note: Straight-line distance is not walking distance. Follow road conditions and local guidance.
strings.candidates.lowAccuracy: Your location may be imprecise ({accuracy}). Check your surroundings too.
strings.destination.note:
Being close doesn't guarantee safety or access.
Follow road and building conditions and local guidance.
strings.destination.openFailed: Couldn't open Apple Maps. You can copy the address and coordinates.
strings.onTheWay.title:
Watch your surroundings.
Head to the site.
strings.onTheWay.mapsBody: Check your location and the roads as you go.
strings.onTheWay.mapsBodyTsunami: Follow your surroundings and local evacuation guidance first.
strings.locationError.title:
We couldn't find
your location.
strings.locationError.body: Location may be off, or it's taking a while.
strings.locationError.pin: Drop a pin on the map
strings.locationError.note: Saved evacuation sites work without a connection or location.
strings.noCandidates.title:
No suitable site
found nearby.
strings.noCandidates.body: No {hazard}-ready evacuation site is registered around here.
strings.noCandidates.cardBody: No site found doesn't mean you don't need to evacuate. Follow your surroundings and local guidance.
strings.endConfirm.title: End the drill?
strings.endConfirm.body: This ends the drill notification and the lock-screen Live Activity.
strings.endConfirm.bodyManual: This ends the guidance and the lock-screen Live Activity.
strings.endConfirm.wallpaper: Change your lock screen back on your iPhone if the wallpaper changed.
strings.endConfirm.safety: Stay somewhere safe and check your surroundings.
strings.settings.privacyBody: What's saved and how location is used
strings.settings.languageNote: Guidance already in progress keeps its language until it ends.
strings.languageUpdate.body: Downloads verified language packs from the server set in Demo connection.
strings.languageUpdate.failed: Update failed. Your current packs are still in use.
strings.demo.title:
Connect the
demo iPhone.
strings.demo.body: Find the connection URL on the demo Mac.
strings.demo.disconnectedBody: Enter the URL and try again. Drills and saved guidance still work.
strings.demo.invalidURL: Enter a connection URL that starts with wss://.
strings.demo.permissionsBody: If they're off, check your iPhone Settings.
strings.demo.note: This connection is for demos and testing. It doesn't mean the app always receives alerts.
strings.privacy.title:
Only what you need
to be prepared.
strings.privacy.savedBody: Chosen public evacuation sites, language and guidance state stay on this device. Sites could hint at where you live or study.
strings.privacy.notSavedBody: The home or school address you typed, its coordinates, search history, and your location during an emergency.
strings.privacy.mapsBody: Location is used only while the app is open. MapKit search and routing send locations to Apple.
strings.privacy.googleNote: Opening Apple Maps hands route guidance to an external service.
strings.delete.title:
Delete
all data?
strings.delete.body: Deletes saved evacuation sites, language, guidance state and demo connection details.
strings.delete.manualBody: iOS shortcuts, changed wallpapers and files saved in Files aren't deleted automatically.
strings.delete.manualHint: Delete shortcuts in the Shortcuts app and choose your original lock screen.
strings.shortcuts.title:
Earthquake and tsunami.
Be ready for both.
strings.shortcuts.body: Add them in order, then set the notification trigger and allow running while locked.
strings.shortcuts.note: Adding, enabling triggers and first-run permissions happen on your iPhone. Downloading alone doesn't finish setup.
strings.shortcuts.footnote: You can also save offline wallpapers and a setup guide.
strings.shortcuts.noOrigin: Set the server in Demo connection first.
strings.liveActivity.disabled: Live Activities are off. Guidance continues in the app.
strings.liveActivity.unavailableBody: Notifications, wallpaper and saved guidance still work.
strings.notification.earthquake.body: [Drill · past data] {time} {place}, max intensity {scale}. Open the guidance when it's safe to use your phone.
strings.notification.earthquake.bodyTraining: [Drill] Earthquake. Protect your head. Open the guidance when it's safe to use your phone.
strings.notification.tsunami.body: [Drill] {time} {area} {grade}. Tsunami coming. Go to high ground.
strings.notification.tsunami.bodyTraining: [Drill] Tsunami coming. Go to high ground. This is not a real tsunami.
strings.a11y.pictogram.protect-head: Pictogram: person protecting their head under a desk
strings.a11y.pictogram.tsunami-evacuate: Pictogram: person moving to high ground away from waves
strings.error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
strings.regions.title: Notification regions
strings.regions.body: Monitor the regions of saved destinations, without using your current location.
strings.regions.connection: Receiving alerts requires a server connection. Locked-screen reception depends on the demo environment.
strings.regions.needsConfirmation: Confirm the regions for every saved destination before enabling.
strings.regions.noneNote: This does not establish safety. You can select regions needed for your living area manually.
strings.regions.confirm: I have checked this destination’s regions
strings.regions.alert.earthquake: Earthquake warning for a registered region. Protect your head.
strings.regions.alert.Watch: Tsunami advisory. Leave the water and move away from the coast.
strings.regions.alert.Warning: Tsunami warning. If near the coast or a river, evacuate to high ground.
strings.regions.alert.MajorWarning: Major tsunami warning. If near the coast or a river, evacuate to high ground immediately.
strings.regions.afterSave: After saving, review or change this under Settings → Notification regions.
